task: photo-editing (flagship 7): cut the noise-aware demosaic's time and memory on full frames (NEXT.md open item)
errors: A benchmark loop's `set --` inside a shell function clobbered $4, so its sampled .npy outputs were written to one path for base and new; byte identity was instead checked by SHA-256 on 14 real raws (tools/noise_aware_cost.py) and by the unit tests.
A first banded blend kept the dense BLAS weight product, which moved ~1 in 1,000 weights by one last bit when cut into bands; replaced with explicit two-tap interpolation, bit-exact in any band.

doc_friction.issue: `PY=$(python3 platform/ci/pyenv.py pytest numpy)` printed /usr/bin/python3.13 while bare python3 (3.11) had no numpy; the pyenv tip worked but the first scratch run used bare python3 and failed.

goal: Deepen the top flagship (photo-editing) with a working engineering slice
notes: Banded/threaded _residual, _block_detail, blend (two-tap weights, in-place out=), in-place clip and threaded bilinear in the noise-aware develop. 14 largest public raws (drewnoakes/metadata-extractor-images), old vs new, one at a time: median 2.2x faster (1.7-2.8x), added peak memory -41% (25-45%), 14 of 14 outputs byte-identical by SHA-256. Venture suite: python3.13 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py photo-editing -> ok (149.7s, 1304 tests, 9 skipped). No agent doc in docs/reports: the eval note and NEXT.md carry what the next run needs.
